detail.longDescription:
My employer @tibhannover@openbiblio.social is looking for a Linux sysadmin with containerization and CI/CD expertise and reasonable fluency in German and English. Details: https://www.tib.eu/en/tib/careers-and-apprenticeships/vacancies/details/stellenausschreibung-nr-42-2026

Among other responsibilities, you'd be working closely with SHIELD, the @tibosl@openbiblio.social project I'm part of (see https://shield.tib.eu), and potentially – if you want – @SafeguardingResearch@fedihum.org.

Job's in #Hannover, with partial remote work options. Application deadline is Nov 1.

#GetFediHired #LinuxJobs #SysAdmin #Kubernetes
